propositions: Operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking diagnostic to verify mapped Jira project keys and legacy_default are visible to the bot outside a full reconcile pass.

The bridge fsck command should gain an optional --live-visibility flag that performs a live visibility check of mapped keys and legacy_default by calling the shared check_mapped_project_visibility helper.

When Jira credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) are absent or incomplete and no probe is injected, the visibility step must gracefully skip with status='skipped' and reason='missing_credentials' without invoking the probe or failing the command.
The live-visibility advisory verdict must be written to stderr in both text and JSON output modes and must not modify the existing stdout JSON schema contract or exit code behavior.
Core rebar doctor command must remain Jira-free with no reconciler or agents optional imports reachable from _commands/doctor.py.
The new visibility step must reuse the shared helper from ticket D (check_mapped_project_visibility) rather than implementing a duplicate Jira existence check.
